# Carl Meredith

## Overview

- **Age:** nine years old  <sub>[v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v5 c31 P27](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0027)</sub>
- **Origin:** Maywater  <sub>[v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Carl  <sub>[v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034)</sub>; Thomas Carlyle  <sub>[v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Carl has clear, bright, dark-blue eyes that are direct and fearless, resembling those of his late mother. He has brown hair touched with glints of gold.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008)_

## Personality

Carl possesses a keen interest in nature, possessing a regular mania for collecting bugs, frogs, spiders, and toads, often bringing them into the house or stowing them about his person. He is fascinated by creatures such as ants and beetles, demonstrating an absent-minded curiosity that draws him into quiet observation. He is also considerate of his father's feelings, showing a willingness to endure punishment without crying to avoid causing his father distress.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008), [v5 c5 P4](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0004), [v5 c5 P12](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0012), [v5 c26 P22](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0022), [v5 c33 P27](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0027)_

## History

Carl lived in Maywater prior to moving to Glen St. Mary when his father was appointed minister of the Glen manse. Often spending time outdoors, he was frequently found studying ants or collecting small creatures like beetles, lizards, and toads. On one occasion, he caught a cellar snake using a forked stick, and on another, spent an afternoon watching an ant bed in the Methodist graveyard with Mary Vance. After getting wet while pursuing dragon-flies in the Rainbow Valley marsh, Carl suffered a severe sore throat and spent several days sick in bed, which contributed to his sisters confusing the days of the week. He co-founded the Good-Conduct Club with his siblings and friends on Hezekiah Pollock's tombstone. Later, Carl became dangerously ill with double pneumonia, but he rallied after a difficult night under the care of Dr. Blythe and a nurse. Following a misdeed that earned him a promised whipping from his father, Carl faced the punishment gamely to avoid adding to his father's regret.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046), [v5 c5 P4](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0004), [v5 c8 P29](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0029), [v5 c10 P18](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0018), [v5 c10 P29](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0029), [v5 c11 P22](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0022), [v5 c12 P6](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0006), [v5 c23 P79](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0079), [v5 c31 P27](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0027), [v5 c33 P23](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0023), [v5 c33 P27](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0027)_
